sources.entry: RetroShare - Secured and decentralized communication system. Offers decentralized chat, forums, messaging, file transfer. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 C++

summary.one_liner: RetroShare is a decentralized, private, cross-platform communication toolkit offering file sharing, chat, messages, forums, channels and boards.
summary.what_it_does: RetroShare is described as a decentralized, private, secure, cross-platform communication toolkit. The README says it provides file sharing, chat, messages, forums, channels, boards and more. The README does not describe the underlying network protocol or encryption details beyond the general descriptors. Building from source requires cloning the repository and fetching the libbitdht, libretroshare and openpgpsdk submodules. Compilation instructions are split into per-platform guides for Windows (MSYS2 and QtCreator), macOS and Linux, which are referenced by filename rather than included in the README. Downloads of the latest release and other builds are linked from the README.
use_cases: building RetroShare from source on Windows, macOS or Linux
how_to_run: git submodule update --init --remote --force libbitdht/ libretroshare/ openpgpsdk/
Follow the platform install guide in the build_scripts directory (Windows MSYS2 or QtCreator, macOS, or Linux)
Alternatively, download a prebuilt release from the Latest release or Other Builds links in the README
notable: Decentralized design with no central server named in the README
Covers file sharing, chat, messages, forums, channels and boards in one toolkit
Build recipes and packaging scripts provided in the build_scripts directory
Cross-platform: Windows, macOS and Linux install guides referenced
caveats: README states that comprehensive and updated build documentation is lacking
Building requires fetching several git submodules and platform-specific toolchains
Platform setup details live in separate guide files not included in the README text
keywords: build from source windows macos linux
